news.headline: Rupee registers gain against US dollar
news.summary: The Pakistani rupee closed at Rs277.40/USD on Monday Sept 7, 2026, a gain of Re0.01 versus the prior close, as the dollar weakened internationally amid Middle East tensions and rising oil prices, per Business Recorder. Open-market dollar rates Rs277.95 (buying) / Rs278.45 (selling). Negligible single-day FX move; logged as impact 1 (routine), consistent with prior similarly small FX moves in this newslog.

news.headline: PSX: KSE-100 sheds nearly 1,000 points amid geopolitical uncertainty
news.summary: KSE-100 confirmed close Tue Sept 8, 2026 at 172,642.16, down 993.91 points (-0.57%) from Mon Sept 7's confirmed close of 173,636.08 (already logged); intraday high 173,736.19, low 171,490.00, per Business Recorder ('PSX: KSE-100 sheds nearly 1,000 points amid geopolitical uncertainty'). Fourth consecutive losing session tied to the ongoing US-Iran conflict (following Aug 31 impact-5 shock, Sept 2 and Sept 7 impact-4 sessions, all already logged); index initially traded near 173,500 before selling intensified around noon on fears of a prolonged Middle East conflict after Iran threatened retaliation against further US strikes, with oil prices rising on supply concerns. Sectors hit: automobile assemblers, cement, commercial banks, OMCs. Index-heavy stocks named trading red: PSO, MARI, POL, MEBL, NBP, UBL. Secondary indices: BR100 19,014 (-131.1/-0.68%), KSE30 51,415 (-288.5/-0.56%), BR30 69,547 (-386.1/-0.55%). Sub-1% net move, smaller magnitude than the prior two impact-4 sessions; logged as impact 3 (notable), per desk criteria Rule 10.

news.headline: OGDC posts record Rs242.4bn profit, declares highest-ever annual dividend
news.summary: Oil & Gas Development Company Limited (PSX: OGDC) reported net profit after tax of Rs242.374 billion for FY26 (year ended June 30, 2026), up 43% YoY, with EPS of Rs56.35 versus Rs39.50 prior year, per The Nation (published Sept 5, 2026, following a board meeting held Sept 4, 2026). The board declared a final cash dividend of Rs6.00/share (60%), taking total FY26 dividend to Rs17.00/share (170%) including Rs11.00/share already paid as interim dividends - described as the company's highest-ever annual dividend. Net sales revenue was Rs449.191 billion; OGDC contributed Rs187 billion to the national exchequer via taxes, dividends and royalties. Logged as impact 4 (material earnings surprise plus record dividend, per desk criteria Rule 10) for this core-tier constituent; escalation flagged.

news.headline: PSX: KSE-100 sheds nearly 1,000 points amid geopolitical uncertainty (afternoon rolling update)
news.summary: Confirms the already-logged Sept 8, 2026 confirmed close of 172,642.16 (-993.92pts/-0.57%) versus Mon Sept 7's close of 173,636.08; Business Recorder's rolling coverage additionally noted the index fell as much as ~2,145 points intraday before recovering into the close, with selling in automobile assemblers, cement, commercial banks and OMCs on prolonged US-Iran conflict fears after Iran threatened retaliation against further US strikes. Tagged to the union of tickers from the already-logged confirmed-close item; no new company-specific driver added.

news.headline: SE Fruits & Vegetables secures PSX approval for IPO to raise up to Rs1.92bn
news.summary: Sargodha-based fruit/vegetable exporter SE Fruits & Vegetables Limited (formerly Shaheen Enterprises) received PSX approval on Sept 7, 2026 to offer 30 million ordinary shares (32.01% of post-IPO capital) via book-building, floor price Rs40/share, max price Rs64/share, to raise Rs1.2bn-Rs1.92bn; lead managers Topline Securities and Growth Securities. Not yet a listed constituent of the desk universe. Logged as impact 2 (minor company item - pre-listing IPO approval), per desk criteria Rule 10.

news.headline: OGDCL, MARI-backed Lundali-1 well starts gas production in Sindh
news.summary: OGDCL and Mari Energies disclosed in PSX filings that Lundali-1 in the Sukhpur-II Block achieved first gas on September 6, 2026; the well is producing 10 MMscfd at 2,000 psi and supplying SSGC. Working interests named by Business Recorder: Prime Global Energies 25% operator, OGDC 30%, MARI 30%, Turkish Petroleum Overseas 15%. Logged as impact 3 (notable production start for listed E&P names, not a disclosed earnings surprise or major contract).

news.headline: Pakistan registers $3.656bn in remittances for August 2026
news.summary: SBP data showed August 2026 workers' remittances at $3.656bn, up 16.5% YoY and 0.7% MoM; Jul-Aug FY27 inflows reached $7.3bn versus $6.4bn a year earlier. Saudi Arabia sent $873.5mn, UAE $749.8mn, UK $563.7mn, US $308.9mn and EU $496mn. Logged as impact 3 (notable external-account support, but not a surprise shock).

news.headline: PSX: KSE-100 sheds over 3,000 points on Middle East conflict, oil surge
news.summary: KSE-100 settled at 168,865.04 on September 10, 2026, down 3,078.55 points (-1.79%) from the prior close, after renewed US-Iran attacks and surging international crude prices triggered aggressive selling. Business Recorder linked the fall to inflation, external-account and macro-stability concerns; oil-heavy and bank tickers were explicitly tagged from the article metadata and related index-heavy names. Logged as impact 4 (material market-wide move tied to war/oil shock, per Rule 10).

news.headline: Thatta Cement moves towards restructuring of Pakistan Services Limited
news.summary: Thatta Cement disclosed via PSX notice that it reached an in-principle understanding regarding the proposed restructuring of Pakistan Services Limited, subject to final definitive agreements. No transaction value, final terms or completion timetable disclosed. Logged as impact 3 (notable corporate restructuring development, still conditional).

news.headline: Cherat Cement announces intention to acquire at least 30% of Nimir Industrial Chemicals
news.summary: Cherat Cement announced an intention to acquire at least 30% of Nimir Industrial Chemicals, covering at least 33.177mn NICL shares under a share purchase agreement, subject to regulatory approvals, commercial terms, due diligence and execution of required agreements. Logged as impact 3 (notable proposed acquisition; not yet definitive/closed).

news.headline: PSX: Buying returns, KSE-100 gains 1% on hopes of easing Middle East tensions
news.summary: KSE-100 recovered on Friday September 11, 2026 to close at 170,511.85, up 1,646.81 points (+0.98%), after an early low of 166,141.17 and a high of 170,764.79. Business Recorder attributed the rebound to reports of Gulf-Iran talks aimed at managing Strait of Hormuz shipping, while noting Brent touched $109.97 and the prior day had dropped 3,078.56 points. Logged as impact 3 (notable rebound below 1%, not a fresh impact-4 shock).

news.headline: Oil jumps 6pc to USD107 on supply concerns
news.summary: Business Recorder reported Brent at USD 107.08 and WTI above USD 100 for the first time since May after a 6% overnight oil jump on supply concerns tied to the Middle East conflict. Logged as impact 4 (sharp commodity move directly relevant to Pakistan external account, inflation and E&P/refinery/OMC sectors, per Rule 10).

news.headline: IMF mission to visit Pakistan in coming weeks for next review
news.summary: Business Recorder reported the IMF mission will visit Pakistan in the coming weeks for the next review of ongoing programs including the Extended Arrangement under the EFF and RSF. Logged as impact 3 (notable macro calendar/review item; no disbursement or programme change yet).

news.headline: Official PSX market summary confirms September 10 KSE-100 close
news.summary: Official PSX market data confirms KSE-100 closed at 168,865.04 on September 10, 2026, down 3,078.55 points (-1.79%). The desk therefore discards the earlier alternate close level from secondary reporting and keeps the September 10 move logged as impact 4 because it was a material market-wide selloff during the oil/geopolitical shock.

news.headline: Oil surges 6%; Brent and US crude both surpass $100 on more tanker attacks
news.summary: Business Recorder reported on September 10, 2026 that oil settled about 6% higher after additional tanker attacks, with both Brent and WTI moving above $100 for the first time in seven weeks. The item reinforces the desk's import-bill, inflation and energy-sector timing risk channel. Logged as impact 4 because it materially affects the macro tape and the large E&P/energy-linked PSX names.
